cases.observations: Reopened the saved Beating waves (interactive) project with source f=4.5 and no active preview. Started its parameter animation and captured an active f=4.15 frame with Stop enabled. Sent the app Home during playback, waited about five seconds, and resumed the same process (PID 14588). The preview had cleared and the panel showed f=4.5 and 'Preview is not saved.' It remained stable for another five seconds. Force-stop and cold relaunch started PID 28649, retained the interactive Graph and f=4.5, and showed no active preview. No stale preview, visible retry loop, or attributable fatal error was observed. The 1664-line background/resume process log and 180-line cold-process log had no filtered fatal/ANR matches; the first contained one non-severe TRIM_MEMORY_UI_HIDDEN notice.

scope: This verifies animation/background and cold recovery on one isolated Notes Check package. No native share/export was started in this case. It does not certify the internal or release package.
